Here's the full file list, modeled on the existing `/api/levelup` and `/api/shop` patterns (deterministic DB transaction, not routed through the AI DM):

**Worker (backend)**

1. **`worker/src/types/index.ts`** — add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string; innId?: number }` interface (and optionally a configurable `cost` if per-inn pricing is wanted).
2. **`worker/src/routes/rest.ts`** *(new file)* — `restRoutes = new Hono()`; `POST /` handler that: parses body, loads character via `getCharacter`, computes `const cost = <flat fee, e.g. 10>` (or looks up an `inns` table rate), checks `character.gold < cost` → 400 "Not enough gold", else calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { gold: character.gold - cost, hp: character.max_hp })`, writes an `adventure_log` entry, and returns `{ success: true, updatedCharacter }`.
3. **`worker/src/index.ts`** — import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`.
4. *(Optional)* **`worker/src/db/schema.sql`** / migrations — only needed if adding an `inns` table for variable pricing; otherwise skip and hardcode the gold cost in `rest.ts`.

**Angular (frontend)**

5. **`frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts`** — add a `RestResponse` interface (e.g. `{ success: boolean; updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }`).
6. **`frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts`** — add `restAtInn(sessionId, characterId): Observable<RestResponse>` calling `POST ${API_BASE}/api/rest`, same pattern as `levelUp()`.
7. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`** — add a `restAtInn()` method that calls the service, on success calls `this.charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` and pushes a narrative/log line; wire a button/condition (e.g. show only when `location` includes "inn").
8. **`frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** — add a "Rest at the Inn (💰 cost gp)" button, disabled when `character().gold < cost` or `hp === max_hp`.
9. **`frontend/src/app/services/character-state.service.ts`** — no new state needed; `setCharacter` already updates `hp`/`gold`, and `hpPercent` computed will reflect the full heal automatically.

No other files require changes.
